about_the_game:
Billiard Of Chaos is a pool game that requires absolutely no ball-striking skills. You will personally control the movement of the cue ball, and simply hitting the red balls will reduce their health. Breaking through the red balls will earn you points.

Main Goal

Each level has a target score. By continuously breaking red balls within the limited time to reach the designated score, you can clear the stage.

Efficient Combat

You can also purchase various pool cues in the level shop, which equip the cue ball with powerful weapons: for example, making the cue ball spray like a machine gun, throwing high-explosive grenades, or summoning purifying beams! You can equip multiple pool cues per battle. Let your imagination run wild and enjoy the fun of creatively sweeping through red balls.

Double the Multiplier

In addition to the base score earned by breaking red balls, you have a multiplier value. The final target score is the product of the base score and the multiplier. The level shop offers various equipment to increase the multiplier, each with different activation conditions. Once the conditions are met, your base score will be multiplied several times, making you unstoppable in the face of ever-increasing score challenges.

Collecting Color Balls

When the score progress bar is full, colored balls will randomly drop onto the table. Simply approach a color ball and press the "Strike" key to automatically pocket it without adjusting the angle. The color balls in the pockets provide multipliers, and when their colors meet certain "ball hand" conditions, you'll receive additional multipliers.

Most equipment effects also require color balls to form specific sequences to activate. Some sequences are very strict, but once achieved, they grant powerful abilities.

Sweeping the Court

When your backpack is loaded with pool cues and equipment, and the pockets hold the best ball hand configurations, relax and enjoy a visually and auditorily stimulating feast!

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i3/AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 750/AMD Radeon R7 260x
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5/AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 4060/AMD Radeon RX 7600
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Billiard of Chaos is a relaxing and stress-relieving roguelite game where you don't need to aim like in real pool game. Simply choose your favorite weapon, obliterate red balls, use scoring items to boost your Scoring Mult, and smash scoreboards for new records!
supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Polish, Russian, Thai, Finnish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Spanish - Latin America
